records.title: Name Update / Correction
records.when_applicable: Applicable when correcting spelling errors, changing the sequence of an existing name, editing or appending initials, updating the name after marriage, divorce or adoption, or correcting enrolment-operator typo or transliteration errors.
procedure: For a standard or minor update within the permitted limit, fill the applicable Aadhaar Enrolment/Update Form and write the name in block letters without courtesy titles, honorifics or aliases.
Visit an Aadhaar Enrolment or Update Centre with the original Proof of Identity document.
The operator scans and verifies the original document, captures biometrics where applicable, and uploads the update request.
Collect the acknowledgement receipt containing the enrolment or update identifier.
For a complete or first-name change, follow the standard update process and provide the official Gazette Notification as the Proof of Identity document.
For exception handling after the normal update limit is exceeded, submit the request through the applicable UIDAI exception route and provide the required supporting documents.
For operator typo or transliteration errors, contact UIDAI through the official support channel, including 1947 where applicable.
The concerned UIDAI Regional Office may manually verify the case and recommend reprocessing where the official exception process allows it.
required_document_categories: Proof of Identity containing name and photograph
Birth Certificate for eligible minor-name cases
Gazette Notification for complete or first-name change
Marriage Certificate, Divorce Decree or Adoption Certificate for applicable exception cases
UIDAI standard-format certificate where officially accepted
example_documents: Government or service photo identity card
records.update_limit: Name can be updated only twice under the standard lifetime limit. Further requests may require UIDAI exception handling.
warnings: Nirdosh Vault does not determine whether a requested name change is legally valid.
Nirdosh Vault cannot know the user's historical Aadhaar update count from the uploaded Aadhaar document.
Providing false declarations may lead to action under the applicable Aadhaar framework.

sources.title: Aadhaar (Enrolment and Update) First Amendment Regulations, 2026
SOP dated 28-10-2021: Name and Gender Update Request under Exception Handling Process
Certificate for Aadhaar Enrolment or Update Circular

supporting_excerpt: In case of complete name change or change in the first name of the resident, the Gazette Notification of name change to be uploaded as PoI document.
Under exception handling, resident will have to submit the marriage/divorce/adoption certificate and request shall be considered by RO.
The validity of this certificate is only three months from the date of issue.

records.title: Date of Birth Correction / Update
records.when_applicable: Applicable when correcting an Aadhaar date of birth, changing a declared or approximate year of birth to a verified date of birth, or correcting a previously submitted proof.
procedure: Fill the applicable Aadhaar Enrolment/Update Form.
For an update, the date of birth must be supported as a verified date of birth.
Present the original Proof of Date of Birth document at an Aadhaar Enrolment or Update Centre for scanning and verification.
Complete the required identity or biometric verification.
If a birth certificate was used previously, provide the corrected birth certificate bearing the same Birth Registration Number where the official rule requires it.
If another Proof of Date of Birth was submitted previously, provide the corrected version of the same document or another document permitted by the official UIDAI rule.
For cases beyond the standard update limit, follow UIDAI's applicable exception-handling process.
required_document_categories: UIDAI-accepted Proof of Date of Birth
Corrected Birth Certificate with the same Birth Registration Number where applicable
Corrected version of the previously submitted Proof of Date of Birth where applicable
Name-change evidence for applicable post-marriage cases
records.update_limit: Date of birth can be updated once under the standard lifetime limit. Further changes are subject to UIDAI's applicable exception process.
warnings: Nirdosh Vault identifies a mismatch but does not determine which document contains the legally correct date of birth.
A year-only or declared DOB must not automatically be treated as a full-date conflict when the year agrees.
The exact accepted document depends on the resident category and the current UIDAI accepted-document list.

sources.title: Aadhaar (Enrolment and Update) First Amendment Regulations, 2026
Certificate for Aadhaar Enrolment or Update Circular

supporting_excerpt: If the Aadhaar number holder had earlier submitted birth certificate as proof of date of birth, the Aadhaar number holder shall submit corrected birth certificate bearing same Birth Registration Number (BRN).
For individual born on or after 01.10.2023, birth certificate is mandatory for enrolment and update.

records.title: Gender Update / Correction
records.when_applicable: Applicable when gender is recorded incorrectly, when an operator error must be corrected, or when a special gender-update case requires supporting evidence and UIDAI review.
procedure: Visit an Aadhaar Enrolment or Update Centre and fill the applicable update form.
Select the required gender value and complete the prescribed verification.
For an operator-error case, re-enrol or submit the update through the applicable centre process and contact UIDAI through the official support route.
The concerned UIDAI Regional Office may verify the case and recommend reprocessing where permitted.
For a medical gender-change case, submit the officially required medical certificate where applicable.
For transition to transgender, submit the officially accepted Transgender Identity Card or Certificate where applicable.
required_document_categories: No document for the standard first update where the official rule permits it
Medical certificate with photograph for applicable medical gender-change cases
Transgender Identity Card or Certificate for applicable transgender update cases
records.update_limit: Gender can be updated once under the standard lifetime limit. Further requests may require UIDAI exception handling.
warnings: Nirdosh Vault cannot approve a gender-change request or authenticate supporting certificates.
Special and limit-exceeded cases remain subject to UIDAI review.

sources.title: Aadhaar (Enrolment and Update) First Amendment Regulations, 2026
SOP dated 28-10-2021: Name and Gender Update Request under Exception Handling Process

supporting_excerpt: Gender update is permitted without any documentary support. Considering the restrictions on number of Gender update, the resident have to submit a medical certificate having photograph issued by surgeon or concerned Authority as POI document.

records.title: Address Update / Correction
records.when_applicable: Applicable when an Aadhaar holder changes residence or needs to correct address details, spelling, locality, post office or PIN code.
procedure: For a document-based update, use the applicable Aadhaar form and provide a valid Proof of Address.
Complete the update through the officially supported online service or at an Aadhaar Enrolment or Update Centre.
For a Head-of-Family-based update, provide the Head of Family's Aadhaar details and the required Proof of Relationship.
The Head of Family must provide the prescribed consent or authentication.
Where officially permitted, an immediate-family-member self-declaration may be used for borrowing the family member's address.
Verify the final address, including PIN code and post office, before submitting the request.
required_document_categories: Proof of Relationship for Head-of-Family-based update
UIDAI standard-format certificate where officially accepted
example_documents: Recent electricity, water or gas bill
Registered sale, gift or rent agreement
Property tax receipt within the permitted validity period
records.update_limit: No lifetime limit is specified in the uploaded official sources.
warnings: The exact accepted Proof of Address and validity period must be checked against the current UIDAI accepted-document list.
Head-of-Family and relationship-based routes have separate consent and document requirements.
Nirdosh Vault does not certify the legal validity of an address document.

sources.title: Aadhaar (Enrolment and Update) First Amendment Regulations, 2026
Certificate for Aadhaar Enrolment or Update Circular

supporting_excerpt: PIN code and Post Office are mandatory.
The address mentioned in the Aadhaar of HoF will be used for the address in the Aadhaar of the child.
Self-declaration from an immediate family member certifying the relationship with the individual residing at the same address.
